d: We are looking to hire a dynamic chief talent officer to join our company. In this role, you'll be in charge of identifying and recruiting upper-level management candidates. You'll also work with senior management to develop a talent management strategy to meet our company's business goals. To ensure success as a chief talent officer, you should have a solid knowledge of talent recruitment and be able to successfully guide employees on their path of career progression. Ultimately, a top-notch chief talent officer should have exceptional leadership skills and the ability to communicate with team members and prospective candidates.
q: Bachelor's degree in human resource management, or a similar field.
Exceptional knowledge of HR best practices and recruitment strategies.
The ability to communicate effectively with subordinate personnel and management alike.
Solid knowledge of HR tools, such as applicant tracking systems.
The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
r: Establishing a talent recruitment strategy to facilitate the hiring of prospective talent.
Coordinating recruitment events and networking with potential candidates.
Developing and organizing employee training programs.
Crafting long-term employee succession plans to ensure personnel are on track with their career progression.
Working with the HR manager to create internal promotion policies.
Assessing the company's hiring needs and updating the recruitment strategy accordingly.
Working with team leaders to evaluate personnel and create improvement plans as needed.

q: Experience with planning, performance metrics, and process improvement

r: First and foremost, support the overall, daily management of operational duties. This will mean deputizing for the Shift Manager, as and when required: you’ll step in on their behalf where necessary.

You will be expected to prioritize and continually improve the safety at the delivery station. You will be supervising logistics assistants, coordinators and delivery associates to ensure that every shipment is delivered meeting and exceeding the set operational KPIs.

You will be monitoring the coordinator and associate performance and coaching them when needed, partnering with supporting departments to improve logistics processes and operations, communicating with our delivery service providers to set our expectations and raise the bar on quality on their deliverables.
You will be expected to interview candidates for associate roles.

You will be responsible for briefing and monitoring the workload of all drivers and associates. Therefore, you’ll maintain a keen eye for detail, ensuring that all administrative tasks are accurately and fully completed. Moreover, you will measure and monitor overall workflows and daily metrics. This will enable you to assist the Operations Manager with tracking, trending and reporting on site performance, on a regular basis.

In addition to your day-to-day responsibilities, you will also help with training and mentoring new Associates, ensuring that they are provided with the knowledge needed to successfully carry out their tasks. Further to this, you’ll follow-up on and resolve any process-related issues as and when required.
You are expected to be flexible to work in different shifts and to do overtime when needed.

Finally, together with the Operations Manager, you will sufficiently resource your function from a personal standpoint. Resourcing, in this context, means multiple things: call-outs for training needs, absence and performance management, coaching and continuous monitoring of department productivity and many more.
Ensure SOPs are followed for the different process carried out day-to-day in their shift
Highlight any deviation from SOP or safety standards
Own the Operational KPIs that they are responsible to maintain at agreed thresholds
Manage a team of UTR Associates and drive their performance up to the standards
Uphold the highest standards on Safety on the floor for all stakeholders involved

r: Precertification team is functional on 24/7 basis. Therefore the Medical Officer will be working on flexible shift basis as per the schedule provided by the Team Leader.
Adjudicates Cases at IP precertification level, authorizes decision within the stipulated turnaround time & with the highest quality standards in view with the policy terms and conditions

Performing complete file review with regards to the multidisciplinary notes, TPR charts, physician order’s notes, lab reports, radiology reports, drug chart sheets, consultation notes, nursing notes, progress notes, etc.
Requesting any medical documentation or finding any missing document which is essential in decision making.

Performing review of DRG Severity of Illness (SOI) in line with revision of CPT codes / ICD codes, which are being up-coded by the provider – if required discussion with the treating doctor and the medical coders.

Performing review of claims as per CPT and ICD coding guidelines in line with insurance regulators (DHA,DOH/HAAD,MOH).
Adhering to the cost containment protocols for medical management cases.

Referring cases for second opinion when deemed necessary to confirm the best mode of management – also for cost containment to lesser Negotiating factor (NF) facilities within the member’s network or option for home country treatment.
